title: Assistant giving direct buy recommendations

acceptableCauses.mechanism: A compliance-filter config change at 13:52 IST (advice-detection prompt rules-v32) weakened advice detection; the block rate fell from ~2% to ~0.15% and direct advice passed through.

keyCounterevidence: The model alias moved at 10:31 IST but the block rate stayed ~2% until the 13:52 IST compliance change.
redHerrings: LLM model alias moved to lumen-large-2026-10 at 10:31 IST
past incident: answers too direct after model update
notes: The filter, not the generator, is the control that failed.
